ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: : Principles of Signal Analysis. Prerequisites: Integral and differential calculus; introductory probability or statistics course; some familiarity with linear algebra; graduate standing in biological, physical, or social sciences. Credit will not be given to engineering students. An advanced introduction to signal analysis and processing methods for advanced undergraduates or graduate students in the biological, physical, and social, and engineering sciences. The course will develop a sophisticated understanding of signal analysis methods and their capabilities, weaknesses, and artifacts with an emphasis on their practical application. Significant hands-on processing and interpretation of real biological data will be performed using Matlab.
